text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Special Week looks wilted as she comes in, and closer inspection reveals bags under her eyes.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: I had a dream where these angry, giant carrots in armor kept yelling that I have to eat daikon radishes…

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: I'm so tired… I don't even know why I had that nightmare. I love daikon radishes…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The strange dream seems to torment Special Week for quite a while…
